events.title: The Symposium (Philosophy Discussion Group)
events.location: North Kirra Surf Life Saving Club, Kirra
events.description: A recurring discussion group offering a platform for engaging with philosophical questions and different perspectives in a respectful, community-oriented environment. Attracts curious and intellectually engaged individuals.

events.title: SURFACE Street Art Festival - Fenceline Exhibition
events.source: City of Gold Coast / SURFACE Festival
events.description: Experience an open-air gallery with public street art, live murals, and exhibitions transforming the Gold Coast. This Fenceline Exhibition runs as part of a two-week festival celebrating creativity.

events.title: Flora: Nature's Gift - a BASA Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition of botanical art presented by the Botanical Art Society of Australia, showcasing nature's beauty through detailed artistic expression. Explore the intersection of science and art.

events.title: Sundown
events.description: A vibrant street party transforming Nerang Street with live bands, DJs, street art by SURFACE Festival creatives, diverse street eats, and cold drinks. An all-ages event with a lively, creative atmosphere.

events.title: Hope Island Jazz presents The Josh Linnett Quartet
events.location: Hope Island Jazz and Cabaret, Hope Island
events.description: An intimate evening of live jazz featuring The Josh Linnett Quartet, offering a strong atmospheric and artistic musical experience. Perfect for those who appreciate nuanced live performances.

events.title: RunNation Film Tour 2026
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A curated film screening showcasing inspiring stories of running, endurance, and human spirit from around the world. Explores adventure, human behavior, and overcoming challenges through cinematic art.

events.title: Live Music at The Grand Hotel
events.description: Enjoy a night of live music at The Grand Hotel, featuring local artists and a lively atmosphere. A chance to discover new music and experience the local Gold Coast scene.

events.title: Seabastion Toast - Feature Artist Exhibition
events.description: Discover the unique works of feature artist Seabastion Toast in this exhibition at Anthea Polson Art. Explore contemporary artistic expressions in a gallery setting.

events.title: BK Monday Morning Bike Ride
events.description: Join the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club for a regular social bike ride suitable for all types of bikes and e-bikes. A great way to enjoy the outdoors and connect with fellow enthusiasts.

events.title: DW M F4 T3 Numinbah to Springbrook Fitness walk
events.description: An organized fitness walk from Numinbah to Springbrook with the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club. Enjoy a challenging outdoor adventure in nature with a social group.

events.title: DW S T2F3 Pirate Park pontoon walk Currumbin
events.description: A guided pontoon walk in Currumbin with the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club. Explore the natural beauty of the area on a social and active outdoor excursion.

events.title: Mt Barney Base Camp Bigriggen
events.description: A multi-day base camp event to explore the scenic Mt Barney area and its surrounds with the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club. Offers an adventurous and social camping experience.

events.title: OT M T4/T5 F4 The Caves Route of Mt Maroon
events.description: An off-track walk exploring The Caves Route on the southern side of Mt Maroon, led by the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club. A more challenging and adventurous hiking experience.

events.title: Lower Portals T3F3
events.description: Join the Gold Coast Bushwalkers Club for a walk to Lower Portals, offering a scenic outdoor experience. A social opportunity to connect with nature and fellow walkers.

events.title: KARAWATHA FOREST CIRCUIT, Logan
events.description: A circuit hike through the 900-hectare Karawatha Forest, including Poet's Rock, organised by the Brisbane/Goldcoast Hiking Meetup. Enjoy a nature excursion and socialise with a mixed-age group.

events.title: The Kokoda Challenge
events.description: A challenging team endurance event offering 30km, 48km, or 96km courses through rugged terrain in the Gold Coast Hinterland. A true adventure-oriented social event testing physical and mental resilience.

events.title: Sacred Rest: Yin Yoga for Letting Go
events.location: Australian School of Meditation & Yoga, Mermaid Beach
events.description: A grounded Yin Yoga class focused on deep relaxation and the practice of letting go. Offers a wellness-oriented experience in a supportive, authentic community setting.

events.title: Chess Get Together at Elanora
events.description: Join players young and old for a game of chess in a welcoming library environment, fostering intellectual engagement and community connection. All skill levels are welcome to participate.

events.title: Knitting Ladies
events.description: A friendly get-together for craft enthusiasts to knit, chat, and share creative projects in a relaxed community setting. Perfect for those seeking creative and social interaction.
